Reviewed history is read from its own archive counters. Invoice totals, tariff costs and billing residuals are separate. Later closed quarter hours use recorded meter deltas and stored retail prices; missing data stay blank. No guessed reset energy or additional undocumented basic charges. The imported archives remain a fixed snapshot.

Live LichtBlick schedules are collected automatically. Earlier estimates are imported once with a standalone script; the module does not download or reconstruct historical prices.

Invoice references stay separate. Calculated costs use observed m3, dated gross unit rates, dated basic charges and the applicable billing conversion. Estimated future conversion and missing consumption remain marked. Aid and invoice residuals are not spread across days.

items.name: ConsumptionReportEnabled
items.caption: Enable daily email at 00:00 Europe/Berlin (after approving the preview)

items.name: ConsumptionReportSMTPID
items.caption: SMTP instance from object tree

Uses the recipient configured in the selected SMTP instance. Reports the previous complete Berlin day: electricity, gas, house/main water and well water. No separate garden row; the main meter includes garden use. Costs follow the reviewed dashboard and flag incomplete/provisional values.

Newly enabled reports start at the next midnight. After a server interruption only yesterday is sent. One recorded send attempt per day avoids duplicate emails; inspect Daily consumption email status for failures.
